shortDescription: Dungeons from Alexander Wales' "This Used to Be About Dungeons": levelled sites across the world map that generate a fresh themed pocket map per party, stocked with Titan Framework creatures and Entad Framework rewards.
body:
## Status
Build order: 1 World (placement, level map, settings, map toggle) → 2 Entry (gizmo, right-click, party dialog, pocket map, exit, once-per-pawn) → 3 Map generation (themes, chambers, dividers) → 4 Creatures → 5 Rewards → 6 Vehicle Framework (ocean dungeons).
Phase 1 tested (runs #40-41, clean). Builds 5-7 (defaults, icon orientation, search + finder) reviewed at 6, not yet tested.

## World (phase 1)
- `DungeonWorldComponent` holds every dungeon as plain data: parallel arrays of surface tile id + level (ushort), saved as byte arrays, plus `genVersion` and `generatedMaxLevel`. Not WorldObjects: thousands would slow the world map. A real site object is made only when a caravan needs one (phase 2).
- `enteredBy`: per tile, the load ids of pawns who entered it (`HasEntered` / `MarkEntered`). Phase 2 must call MarkEntered on entry. Cleared by Generate.
- Placement (`Generate`): tiles in seeded random order; each eligible tile takes a dungeon and blocks every tile within spacing-1 steps (BFS), so dungeons are at least `spacing` apart. Eligible: no world object, land not impassable; water only with Vehicle Framework + ocean setting.
- Levels: 3-octave Perlin over the unit sphere (frequency = roughness). Ranked; rank fraction p gives level 1 + floor(p^skew × max).
- Runs on a new world and on first load of a save without dungeon data. Dev actions "Regenerate dungeons", "Log dungeon levels".
- A dungeon whose tile has a MapParent is blocked: no icon, no inspect line, not searchable.
- `WorldDrawLayer_Dungeons` (added to the Surface PlanetLayerDef by patch): one batched mesh, queue 3530. Custom UVs so texture-up points north (vanilla's quad UVs lay sprites on their side). Tint green → yellow → red → purple by level / generated max. Opacity = layer Alpha.
- Bottom-right world toggles: show/hide icons, and a button opening the dungeon finder. Tile inspect shows "Dungeon: level N".

## Finding dungeons
- Vanilla world search: `DungeonSearchElement` subclass added in InitializeSearchSet postfix; DisplayLabel getter, ElementMatch and DoIcon postfixes. Lists as "Dungeon (level N)"; typing "dungeon" or "level 12" matches.
- `Dialog_DungeonFinder`: non-pausing, draggable world overlay. Party: checklist of free humanlike colonists (ticked first), "Load selected caravan" ticks only that caravan's humanlikes so retainers can be unticked; count shown vs 5, red over cap. Hides dungeons any ticked pawn entered. Level IntRange; distance from a chosen colony or caravan (great-circle, works from orbit), slider up to "any". Results sorted by distance, colour swatch, biome/hills/river/coastal/landmark; click jumps; matching tiles outlined (cap 400), hovered row larger. Filter state static for the session, ticks dropped on a new world.

## Settings (tabs; reset bottom left)
- World tab: show icons, icon opacity (40%), tint by level, spacing (10), max level (30), low level bias (1.5), roughness (7), ocean dungeons with VF.
- Planned tabs: Creatures, Rewards, Parties.

## Agreed design (later phases)
- Each party entering gets a freshly generated dungeon; level never changes. Leave by walking back to the entrance at any time; exit screen like Anomaly's pit gate. No boss, no time limit. If every party member dies, the instance is gone; downed doesn't count.
- Entry: "Enter dungeon" gizmo on a caravan on the tile, and right-click → enter dungeon with a caravan selected.
- Party: up to 5 humanlikes (animals and mechs free). A pawn may enter a given dungeon once.
- Effective level = level × wealth modifier (pawns + their gear; ratio in settings). Points linear for now.
- Creatures: humanlikes (xenotypes), animals, insects, mechs if feasible. Packs. Dungeon Madness near-guaranteed; a pack where 2+ roll without it is entirely free of it. Non-mad creatures tamable. Undiscovered rooms keep creatures suspended.
- Rewards: entads via EntadApi; binding single / whole party / unbound by settings chances.
- Hard deps: Entad Framework, Titan Framework, Harmony. Vehicle Framework optional.

## Textures (placeholder SVG)
- World/TUBAD_Dungeon, UI/TUBAD_ShowDungeons, UI/TUBAD_FindDungeons.

## Mockups
- .circinus/mockups/dungeon-finder.html
